temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual at work. When Jose asks, she says it is personal stuff, thanks him, but does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose had no specific concern that Patricia was distressed; she generally seemed vibrant and normal at work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His general view shifts to suspicion that something may be troubling Patricia, though she is not ready to disclose it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be dealing with a personal issue and is currently private about it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to listen and be available without pressuring her to share.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During lunch, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. She confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and seems open to discussing financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: From Event 1, Jose believed Patricia might be dealing with an undisclosed personal issue, but he did not know it was financial.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He now identifies financial stress as a likely source of her distress and learns she may be receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is overwhelmed by bills and finances and may accept support with budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy and concern, with some hopeful helpfulness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to discuss budgeting and financial planning when she feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that his financial planning offer was not prying and says she is grateful for his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worried that he may have overstepped his boundaries by bringing up financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His worry is corrected by her reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his supportive offer and does not see him as intrusive; he can support her as a friend while respecting privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue being supportive and respectful, while avoiding prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is all good, plans a quiet weekend at home, and remains appreciative but does not share personal or financial details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After Event 3, Jose believed Patricia appreciated his support and might be open to help, but he remained mindful of boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Based on her response, he senses she values his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his support but wants privacy and to manage things on her own; low-pressure availability is appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Stay available and check in casually without pressing for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reports she is busy but handling things. She thanks Jose for checking in and says his support is great.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia preferred privacy while appreciating low-pressure support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change. Her response confirms she is managing and values his supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her responsibilities and appreciates his ongoing friendly support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular, non-intrusive check-ins and offer practical help such as grabbing coffee if needed.
